player_prompt.intro:
Frozen Lake-ah lo kal khawm a che! 

'P' i ni e, grid-ah.
Grid symbol-te:
  ' ' = Frozen surface (kal theihna)
  'H' = Hole (a tla a, game a tawp)
  'G' = Goal (he goal hi thleng rawh)
  'P' = I position ni

Thil ti tur: up, down, left, right (emaw w, a, s, d)
I thil ti tur i sawi ang: [up], [down], [left], [right] emaw [w], [a], [s], [d]

Objective: Start (tlang) atangin goal (zawlna) thleng thei turin hole ah a tla lovin kal.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Thil ti format a dik lo. [up], [down], [left], [right] emaw [w], [a], [s], [d] hi hman rawh.
invalid_move.unknown_action: Hma hriat loh '{action}'. Up, down, left, right emaw w, a, s, d hmang ang che.
invalid_move.hit_wall: You tried to move {action} but hit a wall!

game_action.moved: I {action} hi {row}, {col} ah position-ah kal phakin.

outcome.win: Ka lawm e! I tum chu i thleng ta a ni.
outcome.fell_in_hole: You fell into a hole! Game over. You completed {pct}% of the journey to the goal.
outcome.turn_limit: You reached the turn limit! Game over. You completed {pct}% of the journey to the goal.
